description: sherpa-onnx reference embeddings + skip decisions for the nemo-port cosine/filter-parity gate (tasks 1.1/1.2). Captured out-of-process via embed-probe-sherpa (two ORT runtimes cannot coexist in-process). Clip windows are cde5c264 wall-clock seconds. skipped:true = sherpa dropped the clip (silence gate or sub-minimum audio) — the port must drop the same clips (filter parity).
threshold_policy: margin-derived tiered (panel verdict 2026-07-27): >=0.99 for clips >=2.0s, >=0.98 for [1.5,2.0)s; floors derived from AHC separation margin, revisable only if the margin changes
classification_note: speech_region:false clips are drawn from transcript gaps — they are structurally never chunk inputs (build_chunks consumes only Whisper speech regions), so they are filter/no-cosine classified (task 1.2 'dropped inputs'), not gated on cosine. Cosine tiers apply to speech_region:true clips: >=0.99 for >=2.0s, >=0.98 for [1.5,2.0)s.
